title: Page<HarvestBatch>
description: The pagination envelope of MOS-API-015 over HarvestBatch, for table 10.2-B row R22. Written out rather than referenced from a generic Page schema because MOS-API-015 says 'MUST be exactly' and closes the object. No total member (MOS-API-016); ordering is MOS-API-018's created_at DESC, id DESC.
